items.question: How can an Indian company get US clients without marketplaces?
items.answer: Reach the decision-makers directly with one relevant capability. An Indian software firm we worked with contacted CTOs, engineering heads and operations leaders at mid-sized US retail and logistics companies, and booked 24 meetings that led to 7 shared project requirements and 4 proposal requests, without relying on referrals or project marketplaces.

items.question: Is cold email to US companies legal?
items.answer: Yes. B2B cold email in the US falls under the CAN-SPAM Act, which doesn't require prior consent. Every email needs honest sender and subject lines, a physical postal address and a working opt-out that you honour within 10 business days. This is general information, not legal advice, so confirm specifics with counsel.

items.question: How do you handle US time zones from India?
items.answer: US time zones are 9.5 to 13.5 hours behind India, so messages are scheduled for each recipient's morning in their own time zone. Meetings are booked into US working hours, which usually means evening calls for an India-based team. We agree the calling window with you before launch so nobody is surprised.

items.question: How soon do US campaigns produce meetings?
items.answer: Campaigns usually go live about 18 days after onboarding, and first qualified conversations typically come in weeks 3 to 4, with meeting volume steadier after 6 to 8 weeks. Our four US campaigns booked between 16 and 24 meetings each. Results are not guaranteed and depend on your offer and buyers.
